scope: promotion aborted before the deliberate fault; stable int4 routing was restored and BF16 was scaled to zero
root_cause: ten concurrent attribution probes exercised both time-sliced vLLM processes on one physical GPU; five BF16 probes hit the 60 second gateway deadline, opening the gateway recovery window that caused the following stage's fast 503 responses
remediation: make weighted attribution probes sequential, keep concurrency in the separate k6 drill, and require three consecutive gateway ready probes plus clear SLO alerts after every router rollout
